sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Graphic Art Supply is a manufacturer and distributor of graphic arts products since 1932, serving commercial printers and advertising providers with print media, mounting adhesives, finishing films, and SEG frames.

Industry: Graphics & Printing Supplies · Size: <$50M · Products: Gloss White Blockout Vinyl, Matte White Removable Vinyl, Optically Clear Film, SEG Frames, Mounting Adhesives, Finishing Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Graphic Art Supply scores 24 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (16/25). Nothing was found for event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (53% similar on media, print, graphic, films); Mactac (50% similar on vinyl, graphic, films, media); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (31% similar on films, vinyl, graphic, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
